# watchpoint_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a single escalation policy by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar policy fields only; steps are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_escalation_policy" "example" {
  name = "Primary On-Call Escalation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the escalation policy to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID.
